annotation.authors_or_issuer: AUDA-NEPAD / African Union High-Level Panel on Emerging Technologies (APET)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Voluntary AUDA-NEPAD/APET guidelines for responsible AI in African social protection and welfare systems. They apply seven cross-cutting principles plus sector-specific ones, and recommend measures for Member States: policy frameworks, sandboxes, piloting, legal safeguards, capacity-building, institutions and monitoring. Includes an AI primer and African case studies.
key_provisions_or_claims: Normative, voluntary guidelines that Member States are encouraged to adopt through national law and policy
Seven cross-cutting principles including human rights, fairness, privacy, transparency, accountability and oversight, safety, sustainability
Develop national policy frameworks for AI in social protection
Pilot AI at small scale and provide regulatory sandboxes
Cost-benefit and risk analyses with beneficiary participation
annotation.title_clean: Responsible Artificial Intelligence in Social Protection and Welfare Systems in Africa
